agr.lead: Who wins the most points {perMatch}, not in total. A few lucky games aren't enough: the more you play, the more your own results count.
agr.howText: A win is worth 3 points, a draw 1, a loss 0. Every player starts with a few {average} worth the group's average points per match. Your real matches are added on top, so a newcomer sits near the average and moves away from it as they play.
agr.note: N is a third of the matches the group has played this season, rounded up. It's also the minimum number of matches you need to be ranked, so both grow as the season goes on.

signups.title: 1. Sign-ups
signups.teamsMadeNote: The teams are made. Sign-ups above stay as they are.
signups.notComposed: Not composed yet. {confirmed} confirmed player is in the reserve{bench}. The waiting list is not split automatically. | Not composed yet. {confirmed} confirmed players are in the reserve{bench}. The waiting list is not split automatically.

teams.splitHint: Confirmed players are split at random: one goalkeeper per team when there are two, then defenders, midfielders and forwards evenly, then players with no position. Team sizes differ by one at most. Players already placed stay where they are. The waiting list is not included.
teams.tapHint: Tap a player to move them onto a team, or back to the reserve.
teams.waitingNote: These players are not included in the automatic split. The first player on the waiting list moves up when a confirmed place opens.
teams.addGuest: Add a player who didn't sign up
teams.everyoneHere: Everyone in the group is already here.
teams.needBoth: Put at least one player on each team to confirm.

score.opensLater: The score opens once each team has at least one player.
score.hint: The score is the sum of each team's goals, plus the other team's own goals. An own goal does not count in the scorers table.
score.ownGoalHelp: This goal counts for {team}. Choose the {other} player who scored it. It does not count in the scorers table.
score.saved: Score saved · you can still change it.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.text: This can't be undone. Your name, email and password are erased, and you're removed from every group. Match history (goals, @:{'award.mvpOfTheMatch'} titles) stays for the other players, and is no longer tied to an account.
delete.confirmText: Enter your current password to confirm.

members.note: You can't change your own role. The last admin can't be demoted.

members.demoteText: {name} stays a member of the group. You can make them an admin again later.
